summary: Review SCADA signals, alarms, control loops, and facility robotics use cases. Explore practical oil and gas training and request course details.
lede: SCADA and facility robotics training helps instrumentation, control-room, and operations professionals link facility signals to monitoring and inspection decisions. You practise tracing PLC and RTU paths, checking telemetry, interpreting process trends and alarms, and reviewing control-loop response. You also assess robotics use cases for inspection, verify observations for operational use, and prepare handovers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work with facility instrumentation, control-room monitoring, process operations, or inspection planning and need to connect those responsibilities to practical SCADA and robotics workflows.
audience: Oil and Gas Control Room Operators
Oil and Gas Reliability Engineers using condition
prerequisites: Working familiarity with oil and gas facility operations, instrumentation, or process control is recommended. No coding or programming is required; the course uses SCADA diagrams, sample trends, alarm records, and robotics scenario worksheets rather than live vendor systems.
